---
name: Chapter / exercise request
about: You want a specific chapter or exercise moved up the queue, or you have a suggestion for how a not-yet-drafted chapter should be handled. Chapters 1 and 2 are fully written; ch. 3–23 are skeletons (see the banner at the top of each skeleton file).
title: "[chapter] "
labels: chapter-request
---

## Which chapter or exercise

R&L chapter number (3–23 for skeletons, 1–2 for the drafted sheets) and, if applicable, exercise number.

## What you want

For example: "please drop the ch. 2 shape onto ch. 3 next—I am ready to work the Ch. 2 → Ch. 3 transition", or "ch. 8 (32nd-note density) needs a different treatment because it is a probe, not a mastery target—here is what I would do differently".

## Why

Whatever pressure this is under from your own practice, or from your reading. Not required, but helps prioritise.

## Anything else

Optional.
